mapper.select: select dws_cohort_m.id, #{dates} dates, q.register_dates, q.pkg, q.register_version, q.country, q.event_type, q.cohort_day, q.cohort_user_num, IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0) register_user_num, IFNULL(ROUND(q.cohort_user_num / IFNULL(d_user.user_num, 0), 8), 0) conversion_rate from (select cohort_q.register_dates, cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.register_version, cohort_q.country, cohort_q.`event_type`, cohort_q.cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT dufm.user_id) cohort_user_num FROM (SELECT ufm.`pkg`, ufm.register_version, ufm.`country`, ufm.event_type, ufm.`register_dates` register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ufm.register_date, ufm.create_time) cohort_day FROM dwd_user_finish_mission ufm WHERE ufm.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY ufm.`pkg`, ufm.`register_version`, ufm.`country`, ufm.event_type, ufm.`register_dates`, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ufm.register_date, ufm.create_time)) cohort_q left join dwd_user_finish_mission dufm on (cohort_q.pkg = dufm.pkg and cohort_q.`register_version` = dufm.register_version and cohort_q.`country` = dufm.country and cohort_q.`event_type` = dufm.event_type and cohort_q.`register_dates` = dufm.register_dates and cohort_q.cohort_day = TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, dufm.register_date, dufm.create_time) ) GROUP BY cohort_q.pkg, cohort_q.`register_version`, cohort_q.`country`, cohort_q.`register_dates`, cohort_q.`event_type`, cohort_q.cohort_day) q LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_cohort_mission dws_cohort_m on (q.register_dates = dws_cohort_m.register_dates and q.register_version = dws_cohort_m.register_version and q.country = dws_cohort_m.country and q.pkg = dws_cohort_m.pkg and q.event_type = dws_cohort_m.event_type and q.cohort_day = dws_cohort_m.cohort_day) LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_register d_user on (q.register_dates = d_user.dates and q.register_version = d_user.version and q.country = d_user.country and q.pkg = d_user.pkg)
